name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: Import notices now list each new transaction and sweep the last 30 days for spending still needing a category in Wealthfolio's spending tracker, with a Telegram Dismiss button per row. The daily digest splits budgeted categories from an Off budget section that only appears when unbudgeted money moved.
